verdicts.criticalReason: Path Traversal vulnerability in file upload. The controller directly uses `file.getOriginalFilename()` when creating `destFile` without any sanitization. An attacker could upload a file with a name containing directory traversal sequences (e.g. `../../etc/passwd` or overwriting classes) to write files outside the intended `./data/uploads` directory.

concerns.text: The test suite contains time-sensitive duration assertions (`assertTrue(duration < 2000)`) which are non-deterministic and can flake in CI environments.
Favorites, saved searches, and comments are stored in volatile in-memory collections rather than a persistent database, leading to data loss upon application restart.
